title: Field kits, battlecards, and demo flow scripts for Private Launch
creator: Priya Raman
description: Create a comprehensive enablement bundle for Sales and Customer Success ahead of the Private (VPC/on-prem) launch. Deliverables: 1) Executive battlecard (1 pager) + one-page cheat sheets per persona (Platform Eng, Security, Procurement), 2) Demo scripts and step-by-step runbook for a 15/30 minute live demo with optional recorded assets, 3) Objection handlers and pricing/licensing talk tracks, 4) Release notes summary for field distribution and slide deck for customer meetings, 5) FAQ tailored to legal/security questions and upgrade/migration concerns, 6) Training guide and 60-minute enablement workshop plan for Sales + CS with slide deck and hands-on lab outline. Success metrics: Sales team readiness score >= 80% on post-training quiz; first 10 deals have <2 follow-up technical sessions on basic architecture; enablement assets published in Confluence and Drive by due date.
acceptance_criteria: Executive battlecard approved by Head of Sales and Security (signed off via Slack thread)
Three persona cheat-sheets reviewed by Solutions Engineering and Legal
Demo scripts (15m and 30m) validated in dry-run with SEs and recorded
Release notes summary + one-slide TL;DR created and merged into product release page
FAQ contains answers to top 12 anticipated legal/security questions and KMS/HSM integrations
Training deck uploaded to Drive, runbook published, and enablement session scheduled in the calendar
